title: 2006 AMC 8 Problem 3
statement: Elisa swims laps in the pool. When she first started, she completed \(10\) laps in \(25\) minutes. Now, she can finish \(12\) laps in \(24\) minutes. By how many minutes has she improved her lap time?

solutions.text:
Initially, Elisa swam one lap in \(\frac{25}{10}=2.5\) minutes. Now she swims one lap in \(\frac{24}{12}=2\) minutes.

Therefore, she improved her lap time by \(2.5-2=0.5=\dfrac{1}{2}\) minute.

Thus, A is the correct answer.
hints: Find Elisa’s minutes per lap before and after the improvement.
Compare \(\frac{25}{10}\) minutes per lap with \(\frac{24}{12}\) minutes per lap.
